blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Deputy Speaker Ronaldo Puno said on Tuesday the National Unity Party (NUP) is upbeat on meeting with the People’s Budget Coalition (PBC) to discuss issues tied to the proposed P7.2-trillion national budget for next year. On Monday, the PBC said several lawmakers have invited them to meet and review the House approved spending bill, including the NUP, whose 58-member bloc includes Bataan Rep. Albert “Abet” Garcia, the senior vice chairman of the House Appropriations Committee.
